decisions.decision: Retain a heading-as-routing convention only after reading its actual prose. Aggregate notes must follow current children; family completeness is not established by settled labels.

Retain explicitly requested screen guidelines with user-default styles and print exclusion. This supersedes the prepress aggregate note claiming the permission is declined; direct state, pixel and host-key assertions substantiate selected branches.

Retain separately scoped ordinary reader and optional linearizing writer. Alternative file part ordering is permitted by current primary prose; goals about network speed do not create unconditional performance tests for this product. Keep verifier shared-parser and qpdf-warning qualifications visible.
